purpose: Classify installed geological OSS by reusable calculation responsibility. Package output is never geological authority by itself.

provenBy: edge touch and point touch distinguished by DE-9IM
constraints: A valid coverage does not by itself prove geological plausibility
gap_width is a declared model tolerance, not an arbitrary repair value
make_valid must not silently authorize topology repair

provenBy: ordered two-unit pile preserved upper/lower order
surface contact and facies/subpile concepts exposed
constraints: Do not replace the canonical project event graph
regional priors and boreholes require provenance
cross-validation metrics do not prove a unique subsurface truth

provenBy: two 16x32 anisotropic Gaussian-field realizations computed from Gaussian ranges 12 and 4 at 20 degrees
constraints: Transform sampled thickness fields to preserve positivity
seed and full covariance parameters must be recorded
conditioning observations and support scale must be explicit
Blocked for production until source-linked 3D training images and holdout tests exist
A training image outside its environmental scope is prohibited

capabilities.engineStage: Borehole evidence extraction and interval normalization
constraints: Original labels, datum, units and source rows must be preserved
text parsing is not lithology interpretation authority

capabilities.engineStage: Meshing and geophysical forward/inverse evidence comparison
provenBy: non-uniform 2D grid produced 9 nodes, 4 cells, 12 boundaries and expected cell areas 50, 50, 100, 100
constraints: Physical-property model, survey geometry, boundary conditions and noise model are required
An inversion result is evidence with uncertainty, not a direct lithology label
Never use interpolation alone to invent contacts
Cross-validation and uncertainty must accompany fitted fields

capabilities.blocker: No Noddy executable is installed or discoverable
constraints: Do not claim forward-model execution until the native solver and license/provenance are verified
